synopsis.text: Captain Marvel battles Thanos with the help of Drax the Destroyer and Mantis. Brief appearance by the Avengers (Thor, Iron Man, the Vision, the Swordsman, Captain America, the Black Panther, and the Scarlet Witch). At the end, Captain Marvel realizes that Thanos still needs the Cosmic Cube to drain energy, and destroys it, defeating Thanos and saving the Earth and the Universe, while Death starts to laugh...
Note: This issue contains Marvel Value Stamp Series A #6 Thor
